nl.title: Hoe installeer ik een gratis Let’s Encrypt SSL-certificaat in DirectAdmin?
nl.excerpt: Installeer gratis Let’s Encrypt SSL via SSL Certificates in DirectAdmin.
nl.bodyHtml:
Vraag een certificaat aan als DNS al naar de server wijst; forceer daarna HTTPS.

Voorbereiding

  • DNS correct
  • Domein geselecteerd

Stappen

  1. Account Manager / SSL Certificates → Let’s Encrypt / Free & automatic
  2. Vink domein + www indien nodig
  3. Request/Save
  4. Wacht op success
  5. Optie Force SSL / redirect HTTP→HTTPS
  6. Test https://

Controleren

  • Hangslot in browser
  • Geen mixed content fatale blokkades

Tip: Bij failure: check A-record en of poort 80 bereikbaar is voor validatie.

Let op: Vraag geen cert aan op DNS die elders heen wijst.

Kom je er na deze stappen niet uit? Open een ticket bij TripleZero iT via het klantenpanel. Vermeld hostname, DirectAdmin-gebruikersnaam (geen wachtwoord), domein en wat je al probeerde.

Gerelateerd: wp-https; domain-missing-da.

en.title: How do I install a free Let’s Encrypt SSL certificate in DirectAdmin?
en.excerpt: How do I install a free Let’s Encrypt SSL certificate in DirectAdmin: steps in DirectAdmin → SSL Certificates for free, let, encrypt.
en.bodyHtml:
This guide covers How do I install a free Let’s Encrypt SSL certificate in DirectAdmin. You work in DirectAdmin → SSL Certificates, focusing on free, let, encrypt — not unrelated side quests in other menus.

Preparation

  • Access to DirectAdmin → SSL Certificates
  • Focus of this article: free, let, encrypt
  • Recent backup or snapshot

Steps

  1. Start in DirectAdmin → SSL Certificates. Before clicking, note the current value for free, let, encrypt.
  2. Confirm A/AAAA points at this hosting before requesting a certificate.
  3. DirectAdmin → SSL Certificates / Let’s Encrypt; include apex and www if both are used.
  4. Force HTTPS only after successful issuance.
  5. Test https in a private window; check free loads without a name mismatch.
  6. Rotate credentials tied to free, let, encrypt if abuse was possible.
  7. Schedule monitoring or a follow-up check.

Verify

  • Result for free, let, encrypt matches “How do I install a free Let’s Encrypt SSL certificate in DirectAdmin”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside free let encrypt
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get free, let, encrypt right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if free, let, encrypt touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: DirectAdmin → SSL Certificates, backups, tickets.
